facts.fact: URA's Christine Mirembe said URA issues a TIN for tax-related transactions such as registering a vehicle or land title.
Mirembe said the transition from TINs to NINs is under way to create a single identifier and improve the accuracy of taxpayer records.
Mirembe said integrating the NIN into the tax system will let URA link taxpayer records to the NIN and to records held by other institutions.
